title: Skinny

description.main: Terry Richardson's photographic account of his relationship with his partner Alexandra "Skinny" Bolotow, from their first meeting in 2013 to the birth of their twin sons in 2016. Published by IDEA, London, in 2016 as a 168-page hardcover in an edition of 1,000.
description.extended:
Skinny is Terry Richardson's photographic account of his relationship with Alexandra Bolotow, the partner whose nickname gives the book its title, published by IDEA in London in 2016 in an edition of 1,000 copies.

The 168-page hardcover runs from the couple's first meeting in 2013 to the birth of their twin sons, Rex and Roman, in March 2016. The pictures are domestic and off duty. Bolotow swims, lies on a couch with the couple's dog, and nurses the newborn twins. The sequence is loose rather than chronological, but it closes on the births. The cover prints an underwater snapshot of Bolotow on pale pink cloth beneath the title in script lettering. The book launched with a signing at Dover Street Market New York on 9 September 2016.

Richardson built his reputation through the 1990s and 2000s on direct-flash fashion and editorial work for Vogue, GQ and Rolling Stone, on campaigns for Supreme and Yves Saint Laurent, and on books such as Hysteric Glamour (1998) and Terryworld (Taschen, 2004). Skinny is the most private of his monographs, a single-subject series made at home rather than on assignment. From 2017, after allegations of sexual misconduct from several models, major magazines and fashion houses stopped working with him.
description.artist_bio: American fashion and editorial photographer known for a direct-flash snapshot style; books include Hysteric Glamour (1998), Terryworld (Taschen, 2004) and Kibosh (Damiani). Major clients and publications cut ties with him from 2017 after misconduct allegations.

notes: Shelf: Mollino / Richardson. Edition of 1,000 copies, no ISBN. Launched with a signing at Dover Street Market New York, 9 September 2016.
